Gilat is a very good professor, his class is not easy, but he does teach you everything you need to know. 88% of the grade was based on 11 questions from the three exams, but partial credit was given and if you take the time to actually learn the topics rather than just memorizing hw problems you'll be fine.

Gilat is genuinely one of my favorite professors. His lectures are very clear and helpful. He is a hilarious guy who has a passion for the subject he teaches. He lets you come to his office for office hours anytime that he is in his office. He is clear about what will be on exams. At the end of the day, you as the student have to put in the work.

Best classroom experience I've had at Ohio State! I came for the credit, I stayed for the captivating lectures, and I left with a new view on the world and the people around me. Steven Brown is simply amazing.

Funny professor! Going to class is an enjoyable experience. Youll learn a lot about the philos as well as random tidbits about the world when he digresses:) Easy A Only 2 midterms which you will be allowed a cheat sheet for.
